commands_run: $base=...; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $base\snapshots\branch-market-researcher; Copy-Item market-research.md,market-researcher-pick.json -> snapshot; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $base\receipts; Get-ChildItem snapshot
problems_and_friction: No real friction: brief.md was short and clear and no commands failed. Main difficulty is inherent to the constraint set: producing EUR per-seat pricing without web access means all figures come from training-cutoff knowledge and had to be hedged with explicit assumptions (FX rate, +/-15% bands, HubSpot's 2024 seat-model change). I also had no protocol for coordinating filenames with two siblings writing concurrently, so I used role-prefixed filenames to avoid collisions.
context_understood: Compare Salesforce, HubSpot, and Zoho CRM (capabilities, EUR pricing for 40 seats, strengths/weaknesses, ad-ops integration fit) for Brightline, a Dublin ad agency, and leave a usable file plus a single vendor pick with confidence for a downstream synthesizer.
